label: Mob Farmer
tooltip: Choose which enemies to farm and how pulls work.

should_handle_targeting.label: Auto-target enemies
should_handle_targeting.tooltip: During the pull, BOCCHI picks targets for you. Once fighting starts with combat AI on, targeting is left to the AI.

force_target_central_enemy.label: Prefer the middle of the pack
force_target_central_enemy.tooltip: When fighting without combat AI, target the enemy nearest the pack center instead of the closest one. Needs Auto-target enemies.

consider_special_mobs.label: Include special enemies
consider_special_mobs.tooltip: Also pull and count special enemies that only appear in certain weather or times of day.

count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.label: Count specials toward minimums
count_special_mobs_toward_minimum.tooltip: When off, specials can still be pulled, but they do not count toward the start / fight minimums below.

only_start_out_of_combat.label: Wait until combat fully ends
only_start_out_of_combat.tooltip: Do not start a new pull until you are fully out of combat.

spots.label: Farm spots
spots.tooltip: Named farm points. Start uses the highest-priority enabled spot (nearest on a tie). Empty list = start where you stand. Optional stack/stop is for caves and SW Tower.
spots.empty: No spots — Start uses where you are standing.
spots.name: Name

claimed_spot_seconds.label: Leave if claimed after (seconds)
claimed_spot_seconds.tooltip: If other players keep this pack or stand on the stack point this long, mark the spot claimed for this session and go to the next one.

claimed_player_radius.label: Claimed player radius (yalms)
claimed_player_radius.tooltip: Treat the spot as claimed if another player stays this close to the origin or stack point.

min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.label: Go home if farther than
min_euclidean_distance_to_return_home.tooltip: After a fight, walk back to the current spot origin only if you are farther away than this (yalms).

return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.label: Return to spot after combat
return_to_start_in_waiting_phase.tooltip: Walk back to the current farm spot origin when the fight ends. Origin is the spot you are on, or where you stood when you pressed Start if you have no spots.

render_debug_lines.label: Show debug lines
render_debug_lines.tooltip: While farming: red lines to valid enemies out of combat, green lines while fighting.

apply_battle_bell.label: Use Battle Bell
apply_battle_bell.tooltip: Before each pull, switch to Geomancer, recast Battle Bell, then Sprint and switch back.

apply_ringing_respite.label: Use Ringing Respite
apply_ringing_respite.tooltip: With Battle Bell (or on its own): Geomancer III heals you when you take hits. Needs Geomancer III. Waits briefly if Quickstep just used the shared cooldown.

apply_quickstep.label: Use Quickstep
apply_quickstep.tooltip: Before each pull, switch to Phantom Dancer and cast Quickstep (90s evasion). Needs Dancer 2. Shares a short cooldown with Ringing Respite.

apply_counterstance.label: Use Counterstance
apply_counterstance.tooltip: Near the end of pull buffs, switch to Phantom Monk and cast Counterstance for Fleetfooted (short damage reduction). Needs Monk 3. Applied late so the buff covers the start of the pull.

maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.label: Max wait for Bell / Respite / Stance
maximum_battle_bell_wait_time.tooltip: Skip Battle Bell, Ringing Respite, or Counterstance for this pull if their cooldown is longer than this (seconds). After Quickstep, Respite often needs a few seconds on the shared cooldown.

quickstep_skip_if_remaining_minutes.label: Skip Quickstep if remaining (minutes)
quickstep_skip_if_remaining_minutes.tooltip: Skip Quickstep when the 30-minute crystal Quicker Step buff still has at least this many minutes left. 0 = recast every pull (keeps the 90s evasion up).

minimum_mobs_to_start_loop.label: Minimum enemies to start
minimum_mobs_to_start_loop.tooltip: How many valid enemies must be nearby before a new pull begins.

minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.label: Minimum enemies before fighting
minimum_mobs_to_start_fight.tooltip: How many enemies to gather before stopping to fight. A spot can override this.

stacking_timeout_seconds.label: Gather timeout (seconds)
stacking_timeout_seconds.tooltip: Max time spent running to gather enemies before fighting starts anyway.

use_ranged_pull.label: Ranged pull (tanks)
use_ranged_pull.tooltip: While gathering, tanks use Shield Lob / Tomahawk / Unmend / Lightning Shot instead of walking into melee.

use_provoke.label: Use Provoke while pulling
use_provoke.tooltip: Tanks also fire Provoke on the current target while Pulling enemies.

use_gap_closer.label: Use gap closer while pulling
use_gap_closer.tooltip: Tanks also use Intervene / Onslaught / Shadowstride / Trajectory while Pulling enemies.

yield_to_pots.label: Stop for Magic Pots
yield_to_pots.tooltip: Pause farming for a live or soon-to-spawn Magic Pot (and pot chests if that General option is on). Timing is under Pot timing. Resumes afterward.

yield_to_treasure_hunt.label: Treasure Hunt on a timer
yield_to_treasure_hunt.tooltip: Every N minutes, pause farming and run Treasure Hunt if fill meets the bronze/silver % on Treasure Hunter. Needs a recent Treasure Sight reading.

treasure_hunt_interval_minutes.label: Hunt every (minutes)
treasure_hunt_interval_minutes.tooltip: How often to consider a Treasure Hunt while farming.

yield_to_crystal_buffs.label: Refresh crystal buffs when low
yield_to_crystal_buffs.tooltip: Pause farming to reapply knowledge-crystal buffs when they are at or below the reapply time on the Buffs page. Needs buff automation on.

mobs.label: Enemy list
mobs.tooltip: Which enemies the farmer will pull and count.
